# Sori’s first public release!

Sori is a local-first desktop app for learning Korean through
your own reading and watching material.

## What’s included

- Read TXT files and PDFs with saved reading progress.
- Watch local videos with interactive subtitles.
- Analyze Korean words and morphemes locally using Kiwi.
- Save vocabulary with definitions and its original context.
- Look up words through Wiktionary, KRDict, and embedded dictionaries.
- Watch YouTube videos and fetch available Korean captions.

Core reading, local playback, Korean analysis, and saved vocabulary
work offline. Online dictionaries and YouTube features need internet.

Windows builds are unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized.

This is an early release, so bug reports and feedback are very welcome.
If something breaks or feels confusing, please open an issue!
